_: plan-11859 U5 (D10, a1 F7): the CLI ADAPTER TABLE, one row per CLI an org may run its agents on, the ONE source of every fact about it. src/astryx/core/cli_adapters.py is its only reader (runtime_env derives CLIS and LAUNCHERS from it, launch_flags the flags doctor checks, spawn.sh types `runtime_env.py --launch`). `credentials`: the .env keys that CLI reads, by billing class (subscription: used when present; metered: only on the org's ASTRYX_ORG_LOGIN opt-in). `launcher: false` refuses loudly with its `why` (spawn exits; never claude in its place). A launcher's `launch` is the argv, `{name}` slots filled by spawn and every value shell-quoted ({resume} is 0 or 2 elements); it must carry `channel_flag channel_server` (without it the wire's doorbell is dropped silently) and `{mcp}`, and its `permission_flag` must take `{perm}`. HARNESS AND KEYS (owner 11-16): a CLI is a HARNESS; `name`/`by` are what the Agents tab shows; `speaks`: the API formats it runs on (a key fits it when the key's provider serves one: src/astryx/data/providers.json); `logins`: the providers it signs in to; `signin`: how the Agents tab signs one in (the CLI's args that print a sign-in `link`, take the code, and print the provider's token; `prove`: the args of one minimal call that proves the token before it is stored; `config_dir`: the env var that keeps the CLI's own files in a throwaway dir); `connect` (a launcher's): how a key plugs in, the env vars it reads: login {provider: var}; per format {key: the var for a provider whose native format this is, token + base_url: any other endpoint of that format}; tiers: the model var per tier alias; effort.
